title: WAF Console · CrowdSec
subtitle: CrowdSec LAPI on loopback · fail-closed · CRS OOB log-only · admin network only
search_hint: Click a country or point on the map to filter all tabs. Search is separate.
dash.alerts_24h: LAPI alerts in the last 24 h
map.note: Robinson map of LAPI alert coordinates. No third-party GeoIP.
ga.note: GA4 sessions are real-user volume by country and host. LAPI/GA density separates scanner-heavy countries from user-impact risk. Map coordinates stay CrowdSec LAPI.
ga.title: GA4 precision
ga.inactive: GA snapshot not loaded — LAPI only. Console never sends traffic to Google.
ga.unconfigured: Drop an aggregate GA4 snapshot JSON at WAF_GA_SNAPSHOT_FILE to raise finding precision. Do not call the Google Data API from this console. Do not add gtag to /waf.
th.name: Name
sites.hint: Per-FQDN AppSec filters (allow path, skip in-band rule, host bypass). Keep gRPC/OIDC hosts out of scope. CRS in-band, fail-closed and INCLUDE_LARGE_UPLOADS are not controllable here.
policy.name: Name
policy.skip: Disable in-band rule on this host
policy.bypass: Bypass AppSec for the whole host
policy.path: Path prefix (required for allow; optional for skip)
policy.confirm: I confirm bypass_host (AppSec will stop blocking this FQDN)
policy.hint: Create / edit / delete AppSec policies. Apply sends SIGHUP to the CrowdSec engine (does not restart the orchestrator). If AppSec fails, the previous YAML is restored.
policy.empty: No operator policies — default+vpatch+CRS OOB applies to every in-scope Host
decisions.title: Local decisions
decisions.hint: Only crowdsec/cscli origins. The CAPI community blocklist is omitted. Unban by IP still deletes the LAPI decision. Fail-closed and CRS OOB stay unchanged.
alerts.title: Recent alerts
rules.policy_hint: The UI never enables CRS in-band, INCLUDE_LARGE_UPLOADS or fail-closed changes.
allow.title: Allowlists and operators
allow.note: LAPI /v1/allowlists plus optional parser file. Writing allowlists requires cscli on the CrowdSec host.
engine.p1: LAPI and AppSec listen on 127.0.0.1 only
engine.p3: CRS out-of-band: detect/log, do not ban
engine.p4: This console does not go through the CrowdSec bouncer (anti-lockout)
engine.p6: No orchestrator restart · no CRS in-band · no INCLUDE_LARGE_UPLOADS · no bot challenge
engine.p7: Map uses LAPI geo only · Hub rules are read-only
engine.p8: Mutations that change fail-closed/CRS in-band: none (forbidden in the UI)
engine.p9: Operator control: per-site policies, CIDR allowlist, IP ban/unban
engine.p10: OWASP Top 10:2021 correlation is local; CTI connectors export files only (no outbound push)
owasp.title: OWASP Top 10:2021
owasp.hint: CrowdSec LAPI/AppSec findings mapped to OWASP Top 10:2021. Local enrichment only. File export to MISP, TheHive, OpenCTI STIX — no outbound push.
mitre.title: MITRE ATT&CK
mitre.local: Local ATT&CK Enterprise catalog. No MITRE GitHub download at runtime.
mitre.filter_hint: Click a tactic or technique tile to filter findings. Map country selection filters all tabs.
mitre.open: Open the MITRE tab for full ATT&CK correlation.
dash.traffic_hint: LAPI/AppSec events for the selected domain, last 24 h.
dash.events_hint: Action, country, IP and CrowdSec service. Bot challenge is never listed because it stays OFF.
dash.logs_hint: Time, source IP, host and path from CrowdSec event meta (target_fqdn / target_uri).
dash.origin_hint: TLS probes to the in-scope FQDN on 127.0.0.1 and the public IP.
dash.perf_hint: CrowdSec AppSec process lifetime — not 24 h request volume, cache, or bytes.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.scope: This policy covers the CrowdSec WAF operator console (/waf). It is an administration tool on loopback and the admin overlay. It is not a public website and is not the privacy notice of periciacomputacional.com, neurofocus.com.br, or other origin sites.
privacy.controller: Controller: Petter Anderson Lopes, operating as PERITUM / Perícia Computacional. Contact and professional profile: periciacomputacional.com/sobre.
privacy.data: The console reads CrowdSec LAPI security telemetry (source IPs, URIs, rule names, country codes and coordinates supplied by the engine, decisions, allowlists) and stores operator policy documents plus a local audit JSONL. Lawful basis: legitimate interest and, where applicable, legal obligation to protect networks (LGPD / GDPR).
privacy.not: The console does not load gtag, does not call the Google Analytics Data API, does not send CrowdSec attacker IPs to Google, does not use a third-party GeoIP service, and does not process advertising identifiers.
privacy.browser: The operator browser may keep UI locale (waf-locale-v2) and the selected domain filter (waf-domain-v1) in localStorage. Those keys never leave the workstation except as ordinary browser storage.
privacy.ga: An optional WAF_GA_SNAPSHOT_FILE is an operator-exported aggregate of public-site GA4 sessions by hostname and country (no client_id). Analytics does not contribute until that file has at least one session count greater than zero. Dest default is inactive.
privacy.retention: CrowdSec decisions follow engine TTL (console cap 168h for manual bans). Rotate audit.jsonl with the host log policy (example: 90 days). LAPI alert history follows the CrowdSec allocation, not this UI.
privacy.rights: This UI is not a consumer app and does not answer data-subject requests. End-user IPs appear only as security telemetry inside CrowdSec. Access, correction and erasure follow the operator CrowdSec/LAPI retention process and the public-site notices, not a form in this console.
privacy.contact: Privacy questions: Petter Anderson Lopes via https://periciacomputacional.com/sobre/ . LinkedIn: petter-anderson-lopes. Instagram: @peritopetterlopes.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.accept: By opening this console you confirm you are an authorized operator of the CrowdSec engine it talks to. Unauthorized access is forbidden.
terms.license: The console source is MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 PeritumCT). CrowdSec remains MIT from its upstream project. These terms govern operation of a deployed instance; they do not replace the MIT license for the code.
terms.use: Use the console only to monitor and operate AppSec policies, local decisions and allowlists for in-scope hosts. Do not expose LAPI or AppSec beyond loopback. Do not put /waf behind the CrowdSec bouncer. Do not use the UI to enable CRS in-band, INCLUDE_LARGE_UPLOADS, DisableBodyInspection, fail-open, or CrowdSec 1.8 bot challenge. Those controls stay off by policy.
terms.no_public: The UI is bound to 127.0.0.1 and, in production, an admin overlay. It is not offered to end users of origin sites. Public sites keep their own terms.
terms.warranty: THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED AS IS, WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, as stated in the MIT license. Fail-closed AppSec may block traffic when the engine is unreachable. Operators accept that risk.
terms.law: These operational terms are interpreted under the laws of Brazil, without prejudice to the MIT license. Contact: https://periciacomputacional.com/sobre/
